title: Sotsugyou: Graduation S
overview:
Can you get these 5 girls safely through to graduation!?

Sotsugyou S is a training simulation in which you play a new teacher put in charge of a class of five problem students at a girls' high school: Reiko Takagi, Mika Kato, Mami Shimura, Shizuka Nakamoto and Kiyomi Arai. Plan each girl's weekly schedule to build up her abilities, and spend your days off working a part-time job, resting or patrolling town, where you may catch your students up to no good - how you handle it changes your relationship with them. School events such as the culture festival, sports day and exams test how far they have come. By the end of the third term their abilities decide their futures, and not everyone is guaranteed to graduate.

- Special limited edition with a student handbook and school badge
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Rated for ages 18 and over

君はこの5人を無事卒業させる事ができるか！？
